reviews.name: Alex · fictional photo-walk example
reviews.quote: I would bring Keeper on our Saturday walk, stop when my friend turns around, and take one photograph. The camera comes home with a picture from the day still in view.

reviews.name: Maya · fictional camera-gift example
reviews.quote: I would choose the Solar Gold exterior for a friend’s birthday and put “our next photo walk” on the card. One camera, and a reason to plan the afternoon together.

reviews.name: Jordan · fictional travel-photo example
reviews.quote: I would keep a photograph from my trip on Keeper beside my sketchbook. When I pick up the camera for another walk, that picture would come along until I choose the next one.

press.title: Keeper on a neighborhood photo walk
press.summary: A feature concept about framing a friend, pressing the red shutter and carrying the photograph home.
press.body: The route can be ordinary: a cafe, a familiar stoop, a stop in the park. Keeper is a pocket camera with a color e-paper display. Compose in the small viewfinder, press the physical red shutter and keep a photograph visible on the camera afterward. This illustrated feature pairs the camera with a walking map and photographs of friends to show the story a real product shoot should capture. Printed photographs in the cover are styling props; Keeper does not print photographs.

press.title: Keeper exteriors: graphic lines or garden color
press.summary: A design feature concept comparing Slate Grid and Ivory Garden, with the same camera beneath two different looks.
press.body: Slate Grid uses a graphic grid with restrained red accents. Ivory Garden brings botanical embroidery around a paper-like photograph. The camera controls stay in the same places: a large color e-paper display, one red shutter and a separate small viewfinder. Keeper now offers eight looks: Porcelain White, five individual designs, and Sun & moon A or B. Every choice has the same camera functions. This cover is an illustrative design story, not an independent review or an announced artist collaboration.

press.title: Give one Keeper. Plan your next photo walk.
press.summary: A gift feature concept with Solar Gold, a personal note and time to make photographs together.
press.body: Start with the person you want to photograph with. Choose their exterior, add a note and plan a simple outing together. The Sun & moon image shows two options: A is the left side and B is the right side. Each purchase is one camera with the selected exterior, gift box, lanyard and manual. The camera is US$199 plus US$30 shipping, US$229 total. The ribbon, tissue and invitation in this illustrative cover are photo styling, not additional promised package contents.
